events.title: Billy Bremner is sacked as manager of Fourth Division strugglers 동커스터 로버스 , who are kept off the bottom of the Football League only by an 올더숏 side in massive financial turmoil. The club's youth coach, Steve Beaglehole replaces Bremner as manager. 맨체스터 유나이티드 regain their lead of the First Division with a 2–0 win over 셰필드 유나이티드, who are still bottom of the table. Leeds are held to a goalless draw by 윔블던 , which means that 알렉스 퍼거슨's team are now leading the league by a single point and having a game in hand. 리버풀's erratic form continues with a 2–1 home defeat to 크리스털 팰리스, while 맨체스터 시티 maintain their title push with a 3–0 away win over struggling 사우샘프턴, whose 21-year-old striker Alan Shearer is now being strongly linked with a move to the likes of 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 리버풀.
Bryan Robson announces his retirement from international football after 90 full caps for England since 1980.
벤피카 , the Portuguese champions, join the race to sign Paul Gascoigne and table a £6million bid for him.
아스널's European Cup quest is ended by 벤피카 . 맨체스터 유나이티드's defence of the European Cup Winners' Cup ends with defeat by 아틀레티코 마드리드 .
케니 달글리시's spending spree at 블랙번 로버스 begins with a £700,000 move to bring defender Colin Hendry back to the club from 맨체스터 시티.
케임브리지 유나이티드 move to the top of the Second Division for the first time in their history after beating 입스위치 타운 2–1, putting themselves on course for a unique third successive promotion.

올더숏 manager Brian Talbot resigns with the club well adrift at the bottom of the Fourth Division. With the club in no position to pay for a new manager, team captain Ian McDonald is appointed as player-manager for the rest of the season.
First Division strugglers 노츠 카운티 pay a club record £750,000 for 셰필드 유나이티드 striker Tony Agana .
England secure qualification for the European Championship Finals by drawing 1–1 with Poland in Poznań .
블랙번 로버스 pay a club record £1.1million for 에버턴 striker Mike Newell . The Football Association confirms that the Premier League will open next season with 22 clubs.
The Manchester derby ends in a goalless draw at Maine Road . Leeds go top of the First division with a 2–0 home win over QPR . 애스턴 빌라 move into fourth place with a 1–0 home win over 노츠 카운티.

게리 리네커 announces that he will retire from international football after the European Championships. The first top flight Steel City derby for almost a quarter of a century sees 셰필드 유나이티드 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–0 at Bramall Lane .
에버턴 sign 레인저스 striker Mo Johnston for £1.5million.
게리 리네커 agrees to join 나고야 그램퍼스 Eight of Japan for £1million on a two-year contract at the end of the season.

Justin Fashanu signs for 토키 유나이티드 as manager Wes Saunders looks to boost his side's hopes of Third Division survival. In the First Division, 맨체스터 유나이티드 regain their lead with a 2–1 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 맨체스터 시티's title hopes are dented with a 2–2 draw at bottom-of-the-table 루턴 타운, who have won just two of their first 17 league games.
Leeds regain their lead of the First Division with a 4–1 away win over 애스턴 빌라.
The first penalty shoot-out in FA Cup history sees 로더럼 유나이티드 eliminate 스컨소프 유나이티드 after both Fourth Division clubs draw 3–3 in their first round replay.
Gordon Cowans leaves 애스턴 빌라 for the second time, this time signing for 블랙번 로버스 in a £200,000 deal. His place in the Villa midfield is filled by Garry Parker from 노팅엄 포리스트 for £650,000.

리즈 유나이티드 remain First Division leaders, with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still one point behind and with a game in hand. Third-placed 맨체스터 시티 are eight points adrift of top place. 셰필드 유나이티드, meanwhile, have climbed away from bottom place, and are now just one place and two points adrift of safety, ahead of 루턴 타운 and 사우샘프턴. 케임브리지 유나이티드 remain top of the Second Division, with 미들즈브러 in second place. 더비 카운티, 블랙번 로버스, 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티 occupy the play-off places. Both of the top two First Division side win today, Leeds beating 에버턴 1–0 at home at 맨체스터 유나이티드 beating 크리스털 팰리스 3–1 at Selhurst Park . Down in the Second Division, 케임브리지 유나이티드 are still top after three weeks, one point ahead of second placed 미들즈브러 and third placed 더비 카운티 . 미들즈브러 missed the chance to go top with their 2–1 defeat at fourth placed 블랙번 로버스. 레스터 시티 have broken into the Second Division playoff zone after a 2–1 win over 더비 카운티 at the Baseball Ground . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, among the pre-season promotion favourites, have made a dismal start to the season and are now 17th in the Second Division, having lost 3–0 at 반즐리 .
